dao_punish: The Heaven's will descends upon {name}. Their qi recoils, their flesh remembers the weight of divine displeasure.
Lightning, silent and white, touches {name} once. When it passes, they are lesser — and they know exactly why.
{name} feels a pressure beyond any tribulation settle onto their shoulders. The Heaven has marked them.
Karma's ledger turns a page, and {name}'s name is written in red ink. The Heaven does not forget.
A single word echoes in {name}'s soul: *Repent*. It is not a suggestion.
The Dao bends, just slightly, and {name} finds themselves kneeling in spirit if not in body.
dao_bless: A golden light bathes {name}. Heaven smiles today, and fortune blooms where {name} walks.
The clouds part over {name}'s head — a private sunbeam, sent by the Heaven itself.
Ancient luck, hoarded by the Dao, leaks onto {name} in a warm tide. They feel... favored.
{name}'s dantian purrs with contentment as divine grace sinks into their meridians.
A butterfly lands on {name}'s shoulder, then dissolves into golden motes. The Heaven has spoken kindly.
For one breath, {name} hears the Dao hum its approval. It is a sound few mortals ever know.
register: The Dao stirs. {name} opens their eyes in a world that suddenly has rules, layers, and hidden power. The path of cultivation begins.
A mysterious old man, visible only to {name}, nods once: 'The Heaven has noticed you, {name}. Do not waste its attention.'
{name}'s meridians awaken with a soft chime. Mortal no more in spirit, they take their first step upon the path.
Somewhere above the clouds, a name is written in a golden ledger: {name}. The cultivation world has a new 修士 (cultivator).
{name} feels a faint tug toward the world's 灵力 (spiritual qi) — like a river remembering the sea. The journey of ten thousand miles begins.
A scroll of cloud unfurls before {name}: 'The Heavenly Dao acknowledges your existence. Cultivate, or be forgotten.'
startup: The Heavenly Dao has awakened. A golden thread of fate descends upon this realm — chat, and the world shall remember you.
☯ The Dao stirs from slumber. Cultivation is possible once more in this land. Let the strong ascend and the clever endure.
A pulse of golden light ripples through the realm. The Heavenly Dao opens its ledger: register, cultivate, and carve your name into fate.
